name: Notes app

nodes.label: App entry
nodes.description: Boots the app and routes between the notes list and the editor based on the ?note= query param.

nodes.label: Notes page
nodes.description: Lists all notes, or the search results when a query is given.

nodes.label: Editor page
nodes.description: Edits one note in a textarea and saves it on change. The first line becomes the title.

nodes.label: Notes
nodes.description: Owns the in-memory notes and their lifecycle. Saving writes to local storage, updates the search index, then pushes to the Notes API.

nodes.label: Search
nodes.description: Keeps an in-memory index of notes and answers case-insensitive text queries.

nodes.label: HTTP client
nodes.description: Minimal fetch wrapper that sends JSON and throws on non-2xx responses.

nodes.label: Local storage
nodes.description: Reads and writes JSON values in the browser's localStorage.

nodes.label: Notes API
nodes.description: Backend that stores notes. Receives PUT /api/notes/:id with the full note as JSON.

nodes.label: Browser localStorage
nodes.description: Per-browser key-value store; notes survive reloads but not a new device.

nodes.label: Sync worker
nodes.description: Planned: retry failed saves in the background when the device is back online.

flows.name: Save a note
flows.description: From typing in the editor to the note stored locally and on the server.

steps.label: Edit text
steps.detail: The textarea fires change; the first line becomes the title.

steps.label: Update the note
steps.detail: saveNote puts the note in the in-memory map.

steps.label: Persist locally
steps.detail: All notes are written to localStorage as one JSON object.

steps.label: Re-index
steps.detail: The note is added to the search index so it shows up in results.

steps.label: Push to server
steps.detail: A PUT request sends the note as JSON.

steps.label: Store remotely
steps.detail: The backend saves the note; a non-2xx status becomes an error.

flows.name: Search notes
flows.description: How a query turns into the filtered list on the notes page.

steps.label: Route to list
steps.detail: No ?note= param, so the router renders the notes page.

steps.label: Read the query
steps.detail: With a query, the page asks search instead of listing everything.

steps.label: Match notes
steps.detail: Title and body are matched case-insensitively against the query.

steps.label: Render results
steps.detail: Each match becomes a list item with its title.

description: A tiny notes app: list and search notes, edit one, save locally and sync to a backend.
